adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus a `console.error(...)` on failure with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) explicitly `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `safeParse` fails, and it does not log the Zod error or the Microsoft `responseJson`. Previously, a schema mismatch did not throw at that point and did log both the zodError and the MS response body. This is a verifiable behavior change/regression as described.
